lines.t: To those who are fully awake, who having received the knowledge and love of the Truth,
knowing The Messiah fulfills all in every sense, in all manner
every word written, every word spoken, every action within and without, being altogether The All in All of all things,
Let it be truth undeniable! - Causing all, both great and small, rich and poor, bond and free, to bow down before Him, calling Him Lord!
For this truth is an emblazoned torch,
For HE IS WHO HE IS,
For HE IS WHO HE IS,
And there is none like Him!...
